title: Solstice card contract
description: One card = one coordinate: element (7) x tier (0-9, over, ban) x class (3). Truth: docs/CARDS.md SS5-SS7 and docs/CARDS.md SS1. Read at runtime from game/Config/Solstice/Data/cards.*.json.

element.description: The branch this file carries. Not used at runtime; the per-card field wins.
Seven primal elements, a fixed set (docs/WORLD.md SS1.2).

biText.description: Chinese and English travel together; a missing side falls back to the other.

tier.description: 0-9 regular, "over" for the over-tier, "ban" for the forbidden tier.

element_aux.description: Second tag for multi-element cards. Optional in M0.

class.description: What the card is in the world (docs/CARDS.md SS4).

effect.description: The concrete simulated effect the kernel runs (EEffect in SolsticeTypes.h).

provisional.description: True when the slot exists for playability but its effect / params / animation / visible feedback are not yet authored per card (docs/CARDS.md SS3).

params.description: Effect parameters, written in data-side names. SolsticeDataLoader.cpp ReadParams translates material / species / weather to kernel indices; the kernel reads 'mat', which is the translated index - never write 'mat' in data. Numeric keys: radius, peak, delta_temp, water_delta, strength, count, humidity, cloud. Names: material (ParseMaterial), species (ParseSpeciesKind, first used at M1), weather (ParseWeather names).
